name: 時刻の書式と外部の説明を調整する利用設定
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: Japanese Lighthouse catalog design candidate LH07-0108 時刻の書式と外部の説明を調整する利用設定. Reference hierarchy: ORIGINAL source crop controls radio glyph geometry, proportions, alignment, spacing and control anatomy. The Japanese preview controls exact wording and typography. Official white/forest-green/slate design remains binding. Input images: Image 1: original-source-crop-radio-anatomy-and-section-spacing. Image 2: Japanese-preview-exact-content-layout-and-typography. Image 3: approved-style-reference.
Render the Japanese settings panel as a clean, flat white UI crop on a 390x284 landscape canvas. Use Image 1 for exact radio anatomy, selected/unselected states, section dividers and row alignment. Use Image 2 for the final Japanese layout, exact content and typography. Image 3 supplies only approved surface/gradient craft. Preserve exactly these six strings and no others: 時刻の書式; 12時間表記（例：午後2:00）; 24時間表記（例：14:00）; ウェブ上の説明を表示; 空のメモと、自分のメモの下に表示; プライバシーの説明・お問い合わせ. The Time Format group has two radio rows: 12時間表記 is selected and 24時間表記 is unselected. The second group is headed ウェブ上の説明を表示 and contains one selected radio with the explanatory text. Place thin dividers between groups and above the footer. Keep the footer small and muted. Preserve the preview’s existing Meiryo typography, exact weights, sizes, line heights and wrapping; do not enlarge labels or make spacing cramped. Keep component-specific proportions and compact but comfortable breathing room. Use a tight crop with only the preview’s small white margins, no phone frame, title bar, open menu, status/navigation chrome, watermark, card, extra controls or invented content.
Official constraints: pure white outer canvas; settings and lists remain flat white without an outer card. Selected radio uses forest green (#174C36); unselected radio, fine dividers and secondary text use restrained neutral/slate tones. Preserve exact Japanese text and existing Meiryo typography, weights, line heights and wrapping. No broad mint, excessive gloss or invented data/features. Orthographic clean UI render, no phone/environment, no watermark.
Accent decision: Keep only the selected radio indicators forest green. Use white flat settings surfaces, fine neutral dividers, dark heading/body text, gray examples and small muted-gray footer. No added action button, card, toolbar or decorative color.
LATEST DIRECT OWNER DENSITY CORRECTION:
The owner says the 354x44 LH07-0025 version was too large/spacious, while the 180x28 version was too compact. Use a comfortable middle with readable Japanese typography and balanced label padding. LH07-0025 v006 at 300x40 is the calibration for that segmented control only; never force this size or the prior 180x28 target onto unrelated components. Follow each component original source for anatomy and component-specific proportions.
reviewNotes: At390x284: exact labels/states and canvas ratio. Main title top36 vs20 and left23 vs16; other items close to preview within roughly10px and nearer original crop. Tighten extra-looking parenthetical gaps. Not complete or owner accepted.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
